SEARCH
Package neqsim.process.mechanicaldesign

Class EngineeringDeliverablesPackage

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.mechanicaldesign.EngineeringDeliverablesPackage
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class EngineeringDeliverablesPackage extends Object implements Serializable
Generates the full engineering deliverables package for a field development study.

Given a ProcessSystem and a StudyClass, this class generates all required deliverables and bundles them into a single structured output. The deliverable set is controlled by the study class:

  • Class A (FEED/Detail): PFD, thermal utilities, alarm/trip schedule, spare parts, fire scenarios, noise assessment, instrument schedule, IEC 81346 reference designation schedule
  • Class B (Concept/Pre-FEED): PFD, thermal utilities, fire scenarios
  • Class C (Screening): PFD only

Fire scenarios and the noise assessment are derived from the process itself: one fire scenario per separator, gas scrubber or tank (operating pressure, geometry, liquid level, fluid density and heating value, a 25 mm screening release hole), and one noise entry per compressor and pump (actual absorbed power). The worst-case vessel and the loudest compressor are also reported under the original top-level keys. A representative placeholder, flagged in its basis field, is used only when the process has no vessels or no rotating machines.

Usage: 

 
 EngineeringDeliverablesPackage pkg = new EngineeringDeliverablesPackage(process, StudyClass.CLASS_A);
 pkg.generate();
 String json = pkg.toJson();
 String pfd = pkg.getPfdDot();

    • generateFireScenarios

      private void generateFireScenarios()
      Generate the fire scenario assessment from the vessels in the process.

      One FireProtectionDesign.assessFireScenarios(java.lang.String, double, double, double, double, double, double, double) entry is built for every Separator (including subclasses such as three-phase separators and gas scrubbers) and every Tank in the process, using the vessel operating pressure, geometry, liquid level and fluid. The worst case (largest total hydrocarbon inventory) is also written to the backward-compatible top-level fireScenario key. When the process contains no vessel, a representative placeholder scenario is generated and flagged as such in its basis field.

      Returns:

    • generateNoiseAssessment

      private void generateNoiseAssessment()
      Generate the noise assessment from the rotating machines in the process.

      Every Compressor and Pump is assessed with NoiseAssessment using its actual absorbed power. The loudest compressor (or loudest machine when there are no compressors) is also written to the backward-compatible top-level keys. When the process has no rotating machines a representative 1000 kW compressor is used and flagged in the basis field.

    • buildMachineNoise

      machineType - "compressor" or "pump"
      powerKW - absolute shaft power in kW
      splAt1m - sound level at 1 m in dB(A) from NoiseAssessment
      basis - description of the data basis
